title: Pickup after a delay
summary: Input waits with Delay, casts once, then calls the interface.
when_to_use: Use this when a pickup should wait a moment and then call an interface, with one Cast To at most.
common_mistakes: A common mistake is a Cast To chain for every item, or a Delay that never finishes because it was started on Tick.

nodes.note: Enhanced Input starts the wait. Tick does not.
Delay is the short pause before the pickup.
One Cast To, then the interface.
Interface message. The next pickup does not need a new cast.
